price_basis: Selected pinned provider endpoint public list prices, not global cheapest-model pricing or subscription allocation. Frozen consistently for subsequent standardized comparisons.
formula: sum(inclusive_input/1e6 * list_input_price + billable_output/1e6 * list_output_price) across all components and paid retries
input_accounting: Inclusive provider prompt tokens, including cached subsets, priced once at the uncached input rate.
output_accounting: Provider completion tokens once; reasoning is diagnostic and is never added again. Deduplicate stable response IDs; native/gateway/admin views cross-check rather than add.
applicability: Prospective freeze after C1 pilot results and before C2/C3/C4 primary or scored collection. C1 charges remain observed secondary subtotals. Any C1 standardized repricing is post-hoc, not preregistered economics.
tier_policy: Apply any captured prompt-token threshold override when applicable. Current common 200000-token context metadata is below Terra 272000-token tier boundary; do not silently omit tiers if limits change.
missing_usage_policy: Unresolved unless defensible bounds exist; missing failed-call usage is not zero. Known priced usage can only be labeled a subtotal/lower bound.
secondary_only: Cache-aware pricing including explicit missing write counters
